title: Minimum Credit Score for Mortgage Pre-Approval
content: Our automated underwriting guidelines require a minimum FICO credit score of 620 for conforming conventional mortgages. For FHA loans, applicants with scores down to 580 are eligible with a 3.5% down payment.

title: Debt-to-Income (DTI) Thresholds
content: The maximum qualifying Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio is 43% for standard automated underwriting. Borrowers with significant compensating cash reserves and credit scores above 740 may be approved up to 49.9% DTI.

title: Self-Employed Borrower Income Verification
content: Self-employed applicants must supply two consecutive years of federal tax returns (IRS Form 1040 including Schedule C or K-1). Business bank statements from the trailing 12 months are analyzed to calculate average monthly cash flow.

title: Discount Points and Annual Percentage Rate (APR)
content: Borrowers may purchase optional discount points at closing to lower their ongoing interest rate. One discount point equals 1% of the total loan amount and typically reduces the note rate by 0.25%.
